episodes.title: Dana
episodes.summary: Dana comes to town expecting a warm welcome from family, but she's met with the opposite; some comfort arrives in the form of a new friend.

episodes.title: Sabina
episodes.summary: A nosy neighbour puts the wrong kind of spotlight on Dana before a nasty fall triggers a trip back to the past; Kevin gains first-hand experience of Dana's troubles as the pair are forced to play uncomfortable roles in order to stay out of harm's way.

episodes.title: Furniture
episodes.summary: Dana and Olivia search for the answer to what keeps bringing Dana back to the past; Kevin acts the gracious party goer at the behest of his hosts.

episodes.title: The Waiter from Two Nights Ago
episodes.summary: Back in Los Angeles, Dana and Kevin prepare to return to the past but have to deal with the familiar fallout of their travels.

episodes.title: Winnie
episodes.summary: Dana and Kevin find themselves back on the farm; a confrontation with Olivia makes Dana re-evaluate her purpose; Kevin must find a way to explain his mysterious return to the Weylin family.

episodes.title: Celeste
episodes.summary: The enslaved population faces unforeseen consequences from Dana's well-meaning actions; Margaret's search for Rufus's future wife finds Kevin drawn deeper into the family drama.

episodes.title: Jane
episodes.summary: Tom takes Kevin and Rufus on a trip to town; without Kevin's protection on the plantation, Dana struggles with a vengeful Margaret.

episodes.title: Alice
episodes.summary: Dana finds herself in a dire situation; Kevin chases a runaway slave; Tom seeks to restate order on his plantation.
